The '''Bowlbugs''' are a group of normal {{2|Monsters|Enemies}} found in the {{2|Hive}}. Each encounter features a Bowlbug (Rock) alongside 1 or 2 worker bowlbugs chosen from Egg, Silk, and Nectar types. Individual bowlbugs also appear alongside {{2|Slumbering Beetle}}.

== Bowlbug (Rock) ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Bowlbug (Rock)
|Link   = Slay The Spire 2:Bowlbugs#Bowlbug (Rock)
|Image  = StS2_Bowlbug (Rock).png
|HP     = 45-48
|AscHP  = 46-49
|Powers = {{BD2|Imbalanced}}
|Debut  = Hive
|Type   = Normal
}} 
{{Power Infobox
|Name         = Imbalanced
|Image        = StS2 Icon Imbalanced.png
|Description  = If the enemy's attacks are fully blocked, it becomes {{KW2|Stunned}}.
|Type         = Debuff
|Stacks       = Does not stack
|BetweenTurns = Permanent
|Cap          = 
|GivesToEnemy = Stunned
}}
=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Bowlbug (Rock)}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Headbutt
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (15;{{Asc2|9|16}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Dizzy
|Intent = Stun
|Effect = Stunned. Does nothing.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Uses {{Int2|Bowlbug (Rock)|Headbutt}} every turn. However, if {{Int2|Bowlbug (Rock)|Headbutt}}'s damage is fully prevented by a player, the Bowlbug (Rock) becomes {{KW2|Stunned}} and uses {{Int2|Bowlbug (Rock)|Dizzy}} on its next turn, then resumes {{Int2|Bowlbug (Rock)|Headbutt}}.

=== Notes ===
* The in-game description of {{BD2|Imbalanced}} is somewhat misleading. The Bowlbug (Rock) will become {{KW2|Stunned}} as long as the player has at least 1 {{KW2|Block}} and {{Int|Bowlbug (Rock)|Headbutt|Headbutt's|2}} damage is fully prevented. Some other methods of preventing damage are:
** Playing {{BD2|Buffer}}.
** Reducing the Bowlbug (Rock)'s {{BD2|Strength}}.
** Blocking all but 1 damage and preventing that 1 damage with {{R2|Tungsten Rod}}.
* If the Bowlbug (Rock)'s attack damage is reduced to 0 (such as by {{BD2|Mangle}}) but the player has no {{KW2|Block}}, the Bowlbug (Rock) will ''not'' be {{KW2|Stunned}}.
* If {{KW2|Osty}} takes damage from {{Int2|Bowlbug (Rock)|Headbutt}}, it will not become {{KW2|Stunned}}.
* Since {{BD2|Imbalanced}} is a debuff, {{C2|Misery}} can apply it to other enemies in the fight.
* In {{2|Multiplayer}}, only one player needs to fully block {{Int2|Bowlbug (Rock)|Headbutt}} to {{KW2|Stunned|Stun}} the Bowlbug (Rock).

{{Clear}}

=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Bowlbug (Nectar)}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Thrash
|Intent = Attack1
|Effect = Deals 3 damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Buff
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains (15;{{Asc2|9|16}}) {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Opens with {{Int2|Bowlbug (Nectar)|Thrash}}, then uses {{Int2|Bowlbug (Nectar)|Buff}} once, then uses {{Int2|Bowlbug (Nectar)|Thrash}} every turn after.
